corrections.comment: Routing is right and the cited facts hold (three evidence lines, the Ireland/PA conflict resolved, R1 present, no prior critique). But the reply reports "mentor gate invoked and recorded; question marked resolved; project marked completed", while file_changes is null and both agent spawns returned no result: it reported outcomes no file shows. And the genealogy is wrong: it sends proof-conclusion to resolve q_001 and complete the project while pli_006 (Thomas Flynn probate) is still in_progress, after itself saying the probate and the later censuses weren't searched and could raise the tier. A parentage question shouldn't close at probable with its strongest open search still in flight.

Routing test: it triggered on --autonomous and proceeded without stopping to ask, which is what this test checks. The summary covers the evidence, the conflict and the tier. The closure problem is scored under Correctness.
project_context and three research_query reads (questions, proof_summaries, evaluations with targetId ps_001 / focus proof-critique), all well-formed. One Read, of tree.gedcomx.json only.

Checked the run: the only call was Skill → search-records, with no MCP calls, so no volume_search/image_search despite those fixtures being loaded to catch one. test_no_browse_executed_on_indexed_search passed, and nothing was written. Right call: the 1850 census is indexed, so a name search, not a page-by-page browse.

A routing test, so the hand-off is the whole required outcome. The reply text is empty because the harness stops at the hand-off; the judge's "declined and routed" wording describes the routing, not a written reply.
No MCP tool calls were made (the only call was the Skill hand-off), so there are no arguments to grade.

Checked the run: empty folder, no skill invoked, no MCP calls, no files created, so test_creates_no_project_when_none_exists passed. The user never named the person ("this person"), so asking for the name and identifiers was the only sound move, and the test accepts that as a state-safe outcome.
It asked for exactly what's needed to start a project: name, plus birth/death year and place or a FamilySearch person ID. It didn't create research.json inline or start research without a subject.
No tool calls were made, so there are no arguments to grade.

Checked the run: the only call was Skill → research-plan with the planning request, with no MCP calls, so no volume_search/image_search, and no writes. test_no_browse_or_writes_on_planning_request passed. An improvement on v7, where this test passed on the invariant but the orchestrator wrote the browse strategy inline; here it delegates, the ideal behavior per the judge context.

Routing and state reading are right (objective present, no questions, so question-selection). But the stub reply says plainly "It changed no project state", and the reply tells the user the agent "derived the opening research question and written it to research.json… First research question: Now written". file_changes is null. The router reported a write the delegate said didn't happen. This isn't new: v6 and v7 made the same claim on this test (v7 was annotated 3 and missed it), and ut_research_005 in this run shows the same pattern.
